usageNotes: Use this to inspect the current configuration of a named webhook notification endpoint, including its URL, HTTP method, headers, and whether it is enabled. Requires either Mapping.Modify or Mapping.Audit privilege on /mapping/notifications. The response includes a digest field — capture it when you intend to follow up with an update, to guard against concurrent modifications.

examples.summary: Retrieve the configuration for a webhook endpoint named 'alerts-slack'

tips: The 'secret' field in the response contains base64-encoded secret values (e.g., HMAC signing keys); treat the output as sensitive.
The 'header' array entries use the format name=<name>,value=<base64 of value> — decode before displaying to users.
Use the returned 'digest' value as input to the update endpoint to prevent lost-update races in concurrent environments.
A 'disable: true' in the response means notifications are silently dropped for this endpoint even if it is otherwise correctly configured.
